standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the site structure used throughout, whose coverings make the representable presheaves sheaves.

standard_prerequisites.name: Fibre products and the exactness criterion
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Homology, Example homology-example-fibre-product-pushouts and Lemma homology-lemma-check-exactness
standard_prerequisites.use: Supply the description of the fibre product of a surjection as a kernel and the criterion turning exactness into exactness of the induced sequences of Hom groups.

standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies that the projection from the fibre product along a surjection is again a surjection, which produces the covering used for right exactness.

core_obligations: The sheaf condition (proof lines 1304-1333): for a surjection with kernel, the author shows that the difference of the two projections of the fibre product factors through the kernel and is surjective, so that a three-term sequence ending in the surjection is exact; applying the exactness criterion gives exactness of the induced sequence of Hom groups, which is the sheaf condition for the representable presheaf.
Full faithfulness and left exactness (proof lines 1336-1338): full faithfulness is the Yoneda lemma and left exactness is the exactness criterion applied once more.

Right exactness (proof lines 1338-1350): for a surjection and a section over an object, the fibre product projection is surjective by the universal property, so the resulting covering splits the section locally, which by the characterization of surjections of sheaves makes the induced map of sheaves surjective.
Enough points (proof line 1351): the corresponding criterion for sites supplies enough points for the site under consideration.
proof_roadmap: Verify the sheaf condition by converting it into exactness of a sequence of Hom groups.
Read off full faithfulness and left exactness from Yoneda and the exactness criterion.
Check right exactness locally on a covering provided by the fibre product projection.
Cite the criterion for enough points.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the Yoneda embedding of an abelian category into the abelian sheaves on the site attached to it is fully faithful and exact, and that this site has enough points (statement lines 1291-1302). The proof is a complete argument: the sheaf condition is verified by showing a three-term sequence is exact and converting that into exactness of the induced Hom groups (proof lines 1304-1333); full faithfulness and left exactness come from the Yoneda lemma and the same exactness criterion (proof lines 1336-1338); right exactness is checked on the covering given by the projection from a fibre product along a surjection (proof lines 1338-1350); and enough points is a cited criterion (proof line 1351). The non-formal content is the verification of the sheaf condition and the local lifting. The claim is H2.
